content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in early 2024 (Jan–Feb), especially after sharp declines; adjust downward bias for post-2024-01-31 periods.
- Forecast tends to rise too slowly after price spikes; add a small upward momentum correction (e.g., +0.5–1.5% per day) after peaks.
- Overestimates in late 2024 (Apr–May) — model fails to capture sharp reversals; apply mean reversion rule: if 30-day moving average > 68, reduce forecast by 1–2%.
- Forecast lags true price by 1–3 days in most cases; shift forecast 1–2 days ahead for better alignment.
- After price spikes, model overshoots and fails to correct — apply “cool-down” rule: reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% per day for 3–5 days post-spike.
- In low-price regimes (e.g., <60), model underestimates; increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for 3–5 days to avoid under-shooting.
